brute_force_cross_check.method: O(n^2) exhaustive pairwise dominance over the same n fixed (candidate_id, -novelty_score, ahew_g_per_eq) points, computed independently of nsga2::run in this same binary

objective_definition.caveat: The 'lower ahew_g_per_eq is better' direction is an illustrative convention chosen for this fire to exercise NSGA-II mechanics on the only two live numeric evaluator families this candidate set has (2 of 6 families); it is NOT a portfolio-endorsed design objective. The ranking is AUDIT_ONLY / non-promoting regardless of the direction chosen; amphora-solver-lab's own authority ceiling is unaffected.
objective_definition.objective_0: minimize(-novelty_score), i.e. maximize novelty_score (Tanimoto-distance novelty vs the frozen Phase-0 novelty-corpus.v1.json, U-E2E's live novelty evaluator cell)
objective_definition.objective_1: minimize(ahew_g_per_eq) (amine hydrogen equivalent weight, U-E2E's live property-evaluator cell)
